text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! Are these numbers right? My
weight class
changed?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, that's why I've been busting my
butt like
this.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I knew someone so experienced would
have some sort of secret technique up
their sleeves. I can
feel my body honing
itself as we speak.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
...It sure was a pain in the rear
getting it
out of my
dad, though.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
He'd lose it if he found out I slipped up
and fell
out of my weight class.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Sigh... I've just got to get back to peak condition before he notices.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Which means I'll be using his method for
a while.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Wonder Acute focuses every fiber of her
being on getting back to her target
weight afterward...
Which is to say, she's
back in prime racing shape.
